scenario: When a demo request form submission lands in HubSpot, read company size, country and industry, create or update the contact, and assign it to the right SDR with a Slack ping to that rep.
rule_hooks: territory map by region and employee band

scenario: Scan new emails in the sales@ Gmail inbox, classify each as pricing inquiry, partnership pitch, vendor solicitation or existing-customer question, then forward to the owner, label it, or archive it.
rule_hooks: email category to owner/action table

scenario: For each new Salesforce lead, check whether the email domain matches an existing account; if so, convert it as a contact under that account and reassign it to the account owner instead of the round-robin queue.
rule_hooks: domain-to-account lookup, ownership precedence

scenario: Read newly scored leads in a Google Sheet export, set Salesforce lead priority to Hot/Warm/Cold, and create a same-day follow-up task for the owner only on Hot leads.
rule_hooks: score thresholds and SLA hours per tier

scenario: When reps post discount approval requests in a #deal-desk Slack channel, read the deal size and requested discount, then route each to the sales manager, VP Sales or CFO and log the request on the opportunity.
rule_hooks: discount approval matrix by percent and ACV

scenario: Read incoming emails from prospects' legal teams with redlined MSAs attached, identify the opportunity, and route to standard legal review or escalate to general counsel when liability or indemnity clauses are touched.
rule_hooks: clause sensitivity list, escalation owners

scenario: Review DocuSign envelopes for open-stage opportunities and, per envelope status (declined, expired, viewed-not-signed over 5 days), notify the rep, resend, or move the opportunity back to Negotiation.
rule_hooks: envelope status to action mapping, age thresholds

scenario: When an RFP email arrives at rfp@, extract due date, deal value and required capabilities, log it in the RFP tracker sheet, and assign it to a proposal manager or mark it no-bid.
rule_hooks: bid qualification criteria, proposal team capacity

scenario: Scan Zendesk tickets from accounts renewing in the next 90 days and, when a ticket is urgent or tagged as churn-risk, alert the account manager in Slack and flag the renewal opportunity at risk in Salesforce.
rule_hooks: renewal window, ticket priority/tags

scenario: For Intercom conversations asking about pricing, reply with the public pricing page for self-serve-sized companies and hand off to an account executive with a meeting link for enterprise-sized ones.
rule_hooks: company size cutoff, canned responses

scenario: Read reseller deal registration form submissions, check for conflicts with existing open opportunities, and approve, reject or route each to the channel manager, emailing the partner the outcome.
rule_hooks: registration conflict rules, partner tier

scenario: After discovery calls on the sales calendar, check Zoom attendance, and for no-shows send a reschedule email, update the meeting outcome in HubSpot, and requeue the lead after a second no-show.
rule_hooks: no-show count policy, reschedule templates

scenario: Scan replies to outbound sequences for opt-out language, mark contacts do-not-contact in HubSpot, remove them from active sequences, and notify the sequence owner.
rule_hooks: opt-out phrase list, regional consent rules

scenario: Classify replies to SDR outbound emails as interested, not now, wrong person, or out of office, then book a task, set a nurture date, create a referred contact, or snooze the sequence accordingly.
rule_hooks: reply intent to next-step table

scenario: When customers email billing disputes about a QuickBooks invoice, match the invoice, route pricing disputes to the account manager and billing errors to finance, and note the dispute on the account.
rule_hooks: dispute type to owner, dispute amount threshold

scenario: Read helpdesk tickets mentioning seat limits, new departments or feature-tier requests, and create expansion opportunities assigned to the account's AM with the ticket linked.
rule_hooks: upsell keyword list, account ownership

scenario: Process a sheet of badge scans from a trade show, dedupe against the CRM, and assign hot booth conversations to AEs and everyone else to an event nurture sequence.
rule_hooks: booth rating codes, dedupe and territory rules

scenario: Review Salesforce opportunities with no activity past their stage limit and send owners a Slack digest, escalating to the manager those past close date by more than 30 days.
rule_hooks: per-stage inactivity limits, escalation thresholds

scenario: When reps submit quote requests through a form, read product mix and term, assign to a deal desk analyst by complexity, and set a turnaround due date on the request record.
rule_hooks: complexity tiers, analyst skill/capacity roster

scenario: Route incoming security questionnaires and vendor assessment requests from prospects to the security team, the sales engineer, or a self-serve trust portal reply depending on deal stage and size.
rule_hooks: deal size and stage thresholds

scenario: Process bounce-backs and 'no longer with the company' auto-replies, mark the contact inactive, find their listed replacement, and alert the account owner if the departed contact was the champion or signer.
rule_hooks: contact role importance, bounce type

scenario: When customers submit referrals through a referral form, create the lead with referral source, assign to the referring account's AM, and log the referral reward eligibility in a tracker sheet.
rule_hooks: referral program eligibility rules

scenario: Scan call notes and email threads logged to open opportunities for competitor names and post to the competitive intel channel, tagging the product marketing owner for that competitor.
rule_hooks: competitor list with assigned PMM owners

scenario: For cancellation or downgrade requests arriving in Freshdesk, route to retention AMs by ARR band, apply a save-offer reply template for small accounts, and log a churn-risk opportunity.
rule_hooks: ARR bands, save-offer eligibility

scenario: When customer purchase orders arrive by email, match them to the closed-won opportunity, compare PO amount and terms to the signed quote, and send mismatches to the deal desk while forwarding clean ones to billing.
rule_hooks: PO-to-quote tolerance rules

scenario: Review new product trial signups, enrich with company data, and route business-email signups at target-size companies to SDRs while leaving personal-email signups in automated onboarding.
rule_hooks: ICP criteria, free-email domain list

scenario: When HR posts a rep's departure in Slack, find their open leads, opportunities and accounts and reassign them per the coverage plan, emailing each new owner their inherited book.
rule_hooks: coverage plan, workload balancing caps

scenario: Read prospect emails asking to meet, determine whether they need an AE, SE or exec sponsor, and send a booking link or create the calendar invite with the right attendees.
rule_hooks: meeting type to attendee rules, deal stage

scenario: Process leads shared by technology partners in a shared Google Sheet, check for existing ownership, assign to the partner-sourced queue owner, and confirm acceptance back to the partner by email.
rule_hooks: partner sourcing rules, lead acceptance SLA

scenario: Scan incoming customer emails giving non-renewal or renegotiation notice, match the contract end date, and route to the account owner and legal with deadlines computed from notice periods.
rule_hooks: contract notice periods, auto-renew clauses

scenario: Review rep-submitted duplicate account requests in a Slack channel, check which record has the most activity and open pipeline, and merge or reject with a reply explaining why.
rule_hooks: survivorship rules for record merges

scenario: Read transcribed voicemails left on the sales line, identify the caller in the CRM, and create a callback task for the owner or the inbound queue with priority based on stated intent.
rule_hooks: caller lookup, intent priority levels

scenario: Route inbound leads and inquiries from government and education domains to the public sector team, flag procurement vehicle requirements, and keep them out of commercial round robin.
rule_hooks: domain suffixes, public sector team roster

scenario: Detect emails sent to executives from customer stakeholders complaining about sales or service, log them on the account, and assign an owner response within the escalation SLA.
rule_hooks: escalation severity, response SLA by ARR

scenario: Triage rep-submitted commission dispute tickets in the internal helpdesk, match them to the booked opportunities, and route to sales ops for crediting issues or finance for payout issues.
rule_hooks: dispute category rules, crediting policy

scenario: For opportunities moving to Contract Sent with new customers, check the account's payment history in Xero and route those with overdue balances or above-limit deals to finance for credit approval before sending.
rule_hooks: credit limits, overdue balance thresholds

scenario: Assign inbound international leads to the correct regional sales entity and currency-specific price book, sending EMEA and APAC leads to local teams with a timezone-aware SLA.
rule_hooks: country to region/entity/price book map

scenario: When AEs request a customer reference in Slack, match prospect industry and size to available reference accounts, check usage limits, and route the request to the right customer's AM for approval.
rule_hooks: reference program roster, monthly usage caps

scenario: After a product webinar, read the attendee and Q&A export, route attendees who asked buying questions to AEs, existing customers to their AMs, and the rest into nurture.
rule_hooks: engagement scoring, customer status lookup

scenario: Check inbound emails and form fills from contacts at closed-lost accounts, reopen or create a new opportunity for the original AE if within 12 months, otherwise route to the current territory owner.
rule_hooks: closed-lost lookback window, ownership rules

scenario: When a website live-chat session ends with a visitor asking about buying, the agent reads the Intercom transcript, creates or updates the HubSpot contact, and assigns a follow-up task to the rep for that visitor's territory and company size, posting high-intent chats to the #inbound-hot Slack channel.
rule_hooks: intent keywords, territory and segment assignment matrix

scenario: Submissions to the generic 'Contact Us' web form are read daily from the forms sheet; each is classified as sales, support, billing, careers or vendor pitch, sales ones become Salesforce leads with owner set by round robin, and the rest are forwarded to the right team inbox.
rule_hooks: category definitions, team inbox directory, round-robin pointer

scenario: Callback requests from the pricing page ('call me in the next hour') are read from HubSpot form submissions and assigned to an on-shift SDR based on the shared shift schedule in Google Sheets, with a Slack DM and a 60-minute SLA task.
rule_hooks: SDR shift roster, time-zone business hours, callback SLA

scenario: New inbound leads whose email domain matches an existing paying customer in Salesforce are pulled out of the SDR queue and reassigned to that account's account manager, tagged as expansion, with a Slack note on who the account's champion is.
rule_hooks: domain-to-account match, account ownership, customer status field

scenario: Inbound leads in the HubSpot new-lead view are checked for free-mail addresses, .edu domains, and 'looking for a job' or 'school project' text; matches are disqualified with a reason code and sent a canned reply, and the rest stay in queue.
rule_hooks: disqualification criteria, free-mail domain list, reason codes

scenario: Leads with enrichment showing over 5,000 employees or Fortune 1000 membership are flagged in Salesforce, bypass SDR qualification, and are routed directly to the enterprise AE pod lead with a same-day meeting request.
rule_hooks: employee-count thresholds, Fortune list sheet, segment routing table

scenario: Customer procurement emails asking for vendor setup forms, W-9s, banking letters or supplier portal registration are read from the deals inbox, matched to the open opportunity, and assigned to the deal desk or finance per document type, with the opportunity's next step updated.
rule_hooks: document-type owner map, opportunity stage, request deadline

scenario: Emails from customers stating that the contract or invoice must be issued to a different legal entity or subsidiary are read, the Salesforce account hierarchy is checked, and the request is routed to sales ops for an account update or to legal if a contract assignment is needed.
rule_hooks: account hierarchy, entity change policy, legal review triggers

scenario: Reps' Slack requests in #deal-desk for non-standard payment terms (net 60/90, quarterly in arrears, split payments) are read alongside the deal amount, and each is routed to the approver tier per the terms-approval matrix, with a Salesforce approval record created.
rule_hooks: payment terms approval matrix by deal size, CFO thresholds

scenario: Opportunity notes and emails flagged for non-standard requests (custom SLA credits, data residency, uncapped liability, source-code escrow) are classified by clause type and routed to the matching specialist queue (legal, security, product, finance) in the project tool.
rule_hooks: clause taxonomy, specialist queue owners, deal size floor

scenario: Customer replies asking to extend an expiring quote are matched to the quote in the CPQ/HubSpot record; extensions within 30 days and unchanged pricing are auto-approved and the quote is reissued, while longer or price-protected ones go to the sales manager.
rule_hooks: quote validity policy, extension limits, price-increase calendar

scenario: Requests for a proof-of-concept environment or product samples submitted via a Google Form are checked against opportunity stage and amount in Salesforce; qualifying ones are assigned to a solutions engineer by product line and capacity, others are sent back to the rep with missing criteria.
rule_hooks: POC eligibility criteria, SE capacity sheet, product-line mapping

scenario: Rep requests for technical demo or discovery support posted in the #se-requests Slack channel are parsed for product, region and date, and assigned to an SE using the pairing table and calendar availability, with a calendar hold created and the opportunity's SE field set.
rule_hooks: AE-SE pairing table, calendar availability, regional coverage

scenario: Tickets in the sales-engineering Jira project asking for custom demo data or sandbox builds are prioritized by the linked opportunity's amount and close date and assigned to the demo-ops engineer whose queue has capacity.
rule_hooks: priority score from deal amount and close date, engineer WIP limits

scenario: Emails from companies asking to become resellers, referral partners or integration partners are read from partners@ and classified by partnership type and region, logged in the partner pipeline sheet, and routed to the right channel manager with a templated intake questionnaire sent.
rule_hooks: partner program tiers, regional channel manager map

scenario: Leads arriving from cloud marketplace listing inquiries (AWS/Azure private offer requests) are read from the marketplace notification emails, created in Salesforce with source set, and routed to the marketplace-certified AE for the region with a private-offer task.
rule_hooks: marketplace lead source rules, certified AE list, region map

scenario: Meeting requests for the upcoming industry conference coming in through the event booking form are matched to account owners, assigned to an available exec or AE booth slot in the shared conference calendar, and confirmations are sent with the room details.
rule_hooks: account ownership, exec attendance sheet, booth slot availability

scenario: Requests from AEs for an executive sponsor (VP or C-level) to join a customer meeting are read from a Slack workflow, checked against deal size and strategic-account list, and routed to the eligible exec's chief of staff with a calendar proposal or declined with the reason.
rule_hooks: exec sponsorship thresholds, strategic account list, exec assignments

scenario: When an opportunity is moved to Closed Won, the handoff form submitted by the AE is read and the new customer is assigned to a CSM based on ARR band, product, and CSM book size, with a kickoff task created and the CSM notified in Slack.
rule_hooks: ARR-band CSM tiers, CSM book-size caps, product specialization

scenario: Newly signed customers' replies to the welcome email proposing kickoff times are read and the kickoff is booked on the assigned implementation lead's calendar with a Zoom link, or escalated to the implementation manager if no slot is free within 10 business days.
rule_hooks: implementation lead assignment, kickoff SLA, calendar availability

scenario: Customer emails asking to add licenses mid-term are matched to the account and contract in Salesforce; requests under the self-serve threshold get a co-termed add-on quote created and sent, while larger ones open an expansion opportunity for the account manager.
rule_hooks: add-on threshold, co-term proration rules, account ownership

scenario: Requests from customers to reduce seats or move to a lower plan at renewal are read from the helpdesk, checked against contract terms (minimum commitments, notice window), and routed to the account manager for a save attempt or to billing ops if contractually allowed.
rule_hooks: contract minimums, notice periods, plan downgrade policy

scenario: Daily usage-overage alerts from the billing system are read for accounts exceeding their contracted limits, and each is routed per policy: small overages get an automated notice, large or repeated ones create an upsell task for the account manager with usage figures attached.
rule_hooks: overage tiers, repeat-breach rules, account manager mapping

scenario: Rep requests to structure multi-year deals with price locks or prepaid discounts are read from the deal desk inbox and routed according to term length and prepayment amount to finance, the CRO or both, with the Salesforce opportunity flagged for revenue recognition review.
rule_hooks: term-length approval ladder, prepayment rules, rev-rec flags

scenario: Closed-won opportunities submitted for booking are checked for missing items (signed order form, PO when required, billing contact, tax ID) and either moved to booked or sent back to the rep with a Slack list of deficiencies and the opportunity stage reverted.
rule_hooks: booking checklist, PO-required customer list, required fields

scenario: Emails from customers attaching sales tax exemption or VAT certificates are matched to the account, the certificate's state and expiry checked, and routed to the tax team for validation, with the account's tax-exempt flag updated in QuickBooks once confirmed.
rule_hooks: jurisdiction certificate requirements, expiry dates, account match

scenario: Customer requests to change billing contacts, invoice delivery addresses or remit-to emails are read from the billing inbox, verified against the authorized contacts on the Salesforce account, and applied in Xero or escalated to the account manager when the requester isn't authorized.
rule_hooks: authorized contact roles, verification policy, fraud red flags

scenario: Prospects' requests to speak with a current customer in their industry are read from opportunity notes and matched to the reference program sheet by industry, size and use case, and the request goes to the reference coordinator with a capacity check on how often each reference has been used.
rule_hooks: reference program roster, usage caps per reference, industry matching

scenario: Emails to sales reps from industry analysts, journalists or investor-relations contacts asking about customers or pricing are detected and rerouted to the AR/PR team with the rep cc'd and a reminder not to reply directly.
rule_hooks: sender domain lists of analyst firms and media, comms policy

scenario: Marketing requests to name a customer in a case study or logo slide are routed to the account's AE to confirm relationship health and then to the customer's signer, with the contract checked for a publicity clause and the request logged in the marketing tracker.
rule_hooks: publicity clause in contract, account health score, approver chain

scenario: Emails or Slack messages raising a conflict between a direct rep and a partner over the same opportunity are matched to Salesforce deal registrations and opportunity created dates, and routed to the channel chief with the registration timeline, while both owners are notified the deal is frozen.
rule_hooks: deal registration timestamps, rules of engagement policy

scenario: Rep claims in #sales-ops that an account belongs to their territory are checked against the territory assignment sheet (geography, industry, named lists) and either the account owner is corrected in Salesforce or the claim is denied with the rule that applies, escalating ties to the regional VP.
rule_hooks: territory definitions, named-account lists, tie-break rules

scenario: Requests from reps via a Google Form to fix CRM data (wrong industry, merged contacts, close date edits on closed deals, amount changes after booking) are categorized and either applied by the agent for low-risk fields or routed to sales ops/finance for locked fields.
rule_hooks: field lock policy, low-risk field list, approver by field

scenario: Weekly, opportunities whose forecast category was moved to Commit late in the quarter without a recent customer meeting or a mutual action plan are flagged and routed to the rep's manager for review, with a summary posted to the forecast Slack channel.
rule_hooks: commit evidence criteria, quarter-end timing, manager hierarchy

scenario: Open opportunities with past close dates, missing next steps or zero amounts are pulled nightly, grouped by owner, and each rep gets a Slack DM with fix-by deadlines, with repeat offenders escalated to their manager's queue.
rule_hooks: hygiene rule definitions, repeat-violation thresholds, escalation chain

scenario: New hires' and transferred reps' requests for Salesforce licenses, Gong seats or sales engagement tool access are read from the IT helpdesk, checked against role-based access matrix and license counts, and approved/provisioned or routed to the sales ops manager.
rule_hooks: role-based access matrix, license inventory, approval for exceptions

scenario: Rep submissions claiming a sales incentive (SPIFF) for a qualifying product or deal are read from the comp form, verified against the SPIFF rules and closed-won data in Salesforce, and routed to comp ops for payout or rejected with a reason.
rule_hooks: SPIFF eligibility rules, program dates, closed-won verification

scenario: Feature requests that prospects say block a purchase, logged by reps in a Slack form, are tagged with opportunity amount and stage, deduplicated against the product board, and routed to the right product manager with aggregated deal impact.
rule_hooks: product area owner map, deal-blocker classification, revenue weighting

scenario: Prospects or contacts emailing sales to ask what data is held about them or to delete it are recognized, the request logged in the privacy tracker with a statutory deadline, routed to the privacy team, and the contact's CRM records frozen from outreach.
rule_hooks: GDPR/CCPA request types, response deadlines, outreach freeze rule

scenario: Prospect replies that reschedule or cancel booked discovery calls are read from reps' inboxes, the calendar event and Zoom link updated, the opportunity's next-step date adjusted, and cancellations without a new time routed back to the SDR for re-engagement.
rule_hooks: reschedule vs. cancel classification, SDR ownership, follow-up cadence
